# Tía Tula Blog

> > The official blog of Tía Tula Colegio de Español in Salamanca, Spain, featuring weekly cultural activities, Spanish language immersion programs, and insights into Spanish culture and traditions.

This blog serves students and visitors at Tía Tula Spanish language school in Salamanca, providing weekly extracurricular activity schedules, cultural event coverage, and guides to experiencing authentic Spanish life. Content focuses on language exchange programs, guided tours of Salamanca's UNESCO World Heritage sites, excursions to nearby cities like Ávila and Madrid, and celebrations of Spanish cultural traditions including flamenco, gastronomy, and literature.

## Key Topics

- Tía Tula Colegio de Español
- Salamanca cultural immersion
- Spanish language students
- Weekly extracurricular activities (actividades extraescolares)
- Language exchange programs (intercambio lingüístico)
- Guided tours and excursions
- Plaza Mayor and Salamanca landmarks
- Ieronimus cathedral tours
- Spanish cuisine and gastronomy
- Flamenco and Spanish music
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Ávila and regional excursions
- Spanish literature and Día del Libro
- Cultural events and festivals
- Salamanca University and historical sites

## Spanish Culture & Traditions

- [La gastronomía charra](https://blog.tiatula.com/2018/10/la-gastronomia-charra.html): Salamanca's traditional cuisine: jamón ibérico, hornazo & farinato
- [El flamenco y las escuelas de español](https://blog.tiatula.com/2022/11/dia-internacional-del-flamenco.html): UNESCO-recognized flamenco culture & Spanish schools featuring Camarón
- [23 de abril de 2023, Día del Libro](https://blog.tiatula.com/2023/04/23-de-abril-de-2023-dia-del-libro.html): World Book Day celebrating Cervantes, Shakespeare & Spanish literature
- [Día de la Mujer 2025 en Salamanca](https://blog.tiatula.com/2025/03/dia-de-la-mujer-2025-en-salamanca.html): International Women's Day events at Casa Clara Campoamor in Salamanca
- [El senderismo alrededor de Salamanca](https://blog.tiatula.com/2018/04/el-senderismo-alrededor-de-salamanca.html): Hiking routes around Salamanca: Sierra de Francia, Béjar & La Alberca

## COVID-19 Era Content

- [Books to be free in time of confinement](https://blog.tiatula.com/2020/04/books-to-be-free-in-time-of-confinement.html): World Book Day, Cervantes Prize & virtual Spanish literature during COVID
- [Soundtrack for a confined April](https://blog.tiatula.com/2020/04/soundtrack-for-a-confined-april.html): Joaquín Sabina & Spanish music solidarity during coronavirus confinement
- [Love (for Spain) in the Time of Coronavirus - 6 - Short films about confinement](https://blog.tiatula.com/2020/07/love-for-spain-in-time-of-coronavirus-6.html): Spanish short films exploring COVID-19 lockdown creativity & confinement
